information:
**Atenção**: Esta competição apenas tem eventos vendados e FMC!
## Durante FMC espetadores não são permitidos! Durante os eventos vendados os espetadores devem permanecer em silêncio!
Se vais competir pela primeira vez, certifica-te que lês todas as informações em [Informação Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PleaseBeQuietOdivelasII2026#73040-informacao-importante-important-information), *[ Perguntas Frequentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PleaseBeQuietOdivelasII2026#73041-perguntas-frequentes-faqq)* e no [Regulamento WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
Se és associado da APS tens direito a um **desconto exclusivo de 20%**, sabe mais [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PleaseBeQuietOdivelasII2026#73044-associados-aps-aps-associates).
•
**Attention**: This competition only has blindfolded events and FMC!
## During FMC no spectators are allowed! During blindfolded events spectators must remain silent!
If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PleaseBeQuietOdivelasII2026#73040-informacao-importante-important-information), the *[FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PleaseBeQuietOdivelasII2026#73041-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* and the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
If you're an APS associate you can take advantage of an **exclusive 20% discount**, find out more [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PleaseBeQuietOdivelasII2026#73044-associados-aps-aps-associates).
